content: {"like":["Enjoys bizarre, surreal anime like Dororo for a weird evening","Values strong, realistic acting in Korean thrillers such as I Saw the Devil","Prefers well-researched documentaries with personal interviews, e.g., I Am Steve McQueen","Appreciates high-quality colorization and restoration in classic comedy collections","Loves crisp, clean transfers of classic TV series like Naked City"],"dislike":["Dislikes films with harsh color palettes, especially greenish or reddish tints","Rejects plots that feel too silly or far-fetched in action thrillers","Avoids movies where talented actors seem wasted, like in I Saw the Devil","Finds forced banter and stiff dialogue off-putting in buddy comedies","Dislikes poor visual quality caused by overloading DVDs, as in 4-Movies Western"]}
